name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Capacity is the quiet bottleneck. Broadcom did $16.7B in AI semiconductor revenue last quarter, up 221% year on year, and that has to go through the same packaging lines everyone else wants. Prepaying locks it in, but it ties up cash if demand cools.

Second place at 10% is the more interesting number. Most of that is hyperscalers building their own silicon, not off-the-shelf GPUs. Broadcom did $16.7B in AI semiconductor revenue last quarter, up 221% year on year. Small share, clear direction. $AVGO

Makes sense — if buyers hedge away from Nvidia, Broadcom's custom silicon is one of the few credible alternatives. Still, AVGO closed up 2.5% at $341.60 yesterday, so a lot of that hope may already be in the price. Dec 9 earnings will tell more.
英伟达昨晚财报超预期，Q4 指引 1300 亿美元，2028 年增长展望上调到 75%。AVGO 跟涨 2.5%，收 341.60，站回 20 日线，盘后继续摸到 351 附近。需求没问题，毛利率指引下修是下次财报要盯的点。 $AVGO

The demand-conversion point matters for Broadcom too. If NVDA's backlog converts more slowly, custom XPU orders are usually where it shows up first. AVGO closed Monday at $333.40, below its 50-day of $344.89.

BIS rule reaches past the chips into the plumbing around AI clusters: licences for five countries, 90-day grace for existing data centres. For Broadcom the question is how much overseas build-out slows, not whether demand disappears. $AVGO closed Monday at $333.40, down 3.9%.
周一博通跟板块一起跌，收 333.40，-3.9%。不过 SC26 上产品线没停：Tomahawk 6、Thor Ultra 800G 网卡开始向大客户送样，2027 年量产，瞄准 10 万+加速器集群的开放以太网。股价跌的是情绪，技术进展另算。 $AVGO

Premarket selling is about leadership uncertainty, not AVGO's own numbers. Friday closed at $347.01, right on the 50-day line ($345.38). Tonight's close matters more than the premarket tape. NVDA reports tomorrow, Anthropic prices Wednesday.

The supply-constrained part stands out. 16-18M units in 2029, still growing while capex is supposed to peak in 2028. If Anthropic's ~14M is Broadcom-designed, that's a long runway, but only if supply can actually keep up.
美联储金融稳定报告：受访的 23 家市场机构里，87% 把 AI 列为金融系统首要风险，春天还是 50%。算力相关发债到 10 月已超 6800 亿美元，2023 全年才 1300 亿。博通周五跌 4.8% 收 347.01，贴在 50 日线边上。融资的账，12 月 9 日财报前还得继续算。 $AVGO
